body:
Stay up to date on the latest from Russell Fry's campaign for Congress | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/russellfrysc/russellroundup-8871110?e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=117c0274c9&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
| | UPDATED VERSION OF THE ROUNDUP.
---
|
---
---
| | | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=4a1bc169d4&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**MEETING and GREETING MONDAY**

It was another packed house last evening for a meet at greet at Alan Engel’s lovely home in Pawley’s Island. More than 50 folks showed up. To host a meet and greet, please email [phillip@russellfrysc.com](mailto:phillip@russellfrysc.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20host%20a%20meet%20and%20greet).
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=8e33db9057&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**MOMS STANDING UP FOR LIBERTY**

Russell Fry believes, just like you do, that it is the responsibility of mothers and fathers to raise their children, not the state. One of the most positive, hopeful, and encouraging developments recently is how parents are rising up and pushing back against education bureaucrats who’ve grown too big for their britches. On Tuesday, he spoke at the **Moms for Liberty** leadership training session in Columbia about how to effectively deliver your message to state legislators. Russell enjoyed meeting these great patriots from all across our state.
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=5202a2c81d&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**ON THE GO SATURDAY!**

Russell was racing down the campaign trail at lighting speed last Saturday. He started off by talking with the **_Horry County Punishers LEMC_** and others for their benefit for the Orange Heart Foundation. Great group of bikers and a great cause. In fact, their bikes run almost as hard as Russell does!

Following that he talked to folks at the **_Socastee Heritage Festival_**. After that, it was on to **_the Dillon Celebrates Main Street Festival._**
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=dd92bcb685&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**VOLUNTEER(S) OF THE WEEK!**

This week was a tough week to pick just one volunteer, so we picked two! Congratulations to Rob & Michelle Visconti. In the past few weeks, these rockstars have made thousands of calls, fed volunteers, and put out signs.

We couldn't run our campaign without them! Thanks again to Rob and Michelle!
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=1ee344edac&e=7aa6ac5965)
---
**WILL YOU HELP RUSSELL WITH YOUR DONATION?**

May is now upon us, and the June 14 primary is closer than ever. Friends, Russell Fry needs your help right now. He’s running against a Washington Insider who’s sitting on a couple of million dollars in the bank. Whether you can give $25, $50, $100, or $1,000, any amount you can share is both desperately needed and much appreciated. [_Click here to donate_](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=04a856528b&e=7aa6ac5965). And thank you!

---
|
---
| **DEBATE TICKETS**
We have a few tickets left for the debate tomorrow night in Florence. If you would like some, please send an email to [phillip@russellfrysc.com](mailto:phillip@russellfrysc.com?subject=I%20want%20debate%20tickets).

**WE WANT YOU!**
Looking to get involved in Russell’s campaign? With plenty of opportunities available, there’s something for everyone. [_Click here_](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=4f168ccd91&e=7aa6ac5965) to volunteer, and we’ll be in touch with you soon.

**Pssst! PASS IT ON!**
Help spread the word of what Russell is doing here in the 7th Congressional District. Please take a moment and forward this newsletter to 10 of your neighbors, relatives, co-workers, and friends. They’ll be glad you did!

**COUNTDOWN TO ELECTION DAY!**
There are just **_6_** weeks until polls open on June 14th!
---
|

clean_body: | | | On Monday, we learned that – according to reports – the Supreme Court is planning on overturning its landmark ruling in Roe v. Wade. And while it's not official yet – reproductive rights are still protected in Oregon and across the country – it's time to act. Now. = Republicans spent years packing our nation's courts with right-wing judges and justices willing to do their dirty work for them behind closed doors. The majority of Americans don't support a federal ban on abortion, but we know that's coming if the Supreme Court follows through on overturning Roe , and if Republicans succeed in taking back control of our country. Americans understand that this is about a fundamental right to privacy, and the right for women to control their own bodies and health care decisions. Overturning Roe is just the tip of the iceberg. If Republicans take back control of Congress and the White House, there's no doubt they will continue doing everything in their power to strip away decades of fundamental constitutional rights. The right to contraception, the right to marry who you love, the right to live freely without the threat of government intrusion is under full-fledged attack from the right. = Donald Trump ran on an explicit promise: to turn the Supreme Court over to anti-abortion extremists who would look to overturn Roe v. Wade. Unfortunately, it looks like that may be the one promise to the American people he actually kept. Giving in is not an option. This November, Americans have a clear choice on the ballot: to do away with decades of fundamental protections and the right to live your life without government intrusion or to build on the progress we've made and safeguard these rights for generations to come. We must expand our progressive majority to protect access to safe and legal abortion—winning crucial swing seats in state legislatures, building a big, progressive bench to run and fight everywhere, and organizing across America (and not just in a few narrow districts). name: Cecile Richards
subject: The first person to call me yesterday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
The only way to fight back is getting serious about power.
#
Many of us knew this day was coming. But like people all throughout America, I still woke up yesterday morning struggling to comprehend the dangerous news that the Supreme Court is poised to strike down _Roe v. Wade._
Access to safe, legal abortion has changed everything for women in America. The ability to finish school, plan a family, pursue a career, support your children. Now, all of those freedoms are in peril.
In Texas, women have already had to leave the state to receive reproductive care thanks to Greg Abbott’s extreme six-week abortion ban. Now, nearby states like Mississippi and Oklahoma are poised to ban abortion outright, and Texans are going to have no place to go.
To be honest, these thoughts overwhelmed me as soon as I woke up yesterday. **Then my phone rang.** It was Beto, one of the first people to call me about the news.
I was immediately struck by how much Beto cares about what’s happening to people in Texas and across the country. He cares about those who are being affected by this painful news.
We talked about Justice Alito’s draft opinion, which is full of callous disregard for pregnant people and for women. Then we talked about how it’s a mirror reflection of what we’re seeing in Texas from Greg Abbott and other Republican leaders.
Greg Abbott is so craven that he’s willing to trade off the future of generations of women for his own political purposes. They’re cynically using this issue to drive a divide between people in Texas. It’s not about life. It’s about power.
**Beto and I agree: The only way to fight back is by getting serious about power, too.**
As difficult as this moment is, we have the opportunity to channel the anger we feel into real action. Gaining political power is the only way to meet this challenge — and if the Supreme Court is going to leave it up to the states to decide who’s in control over a woman’s body, we MUST come together and elect a governor in Texas who believes in a woman’s right to choose.
[**Please contribute $3 or more right now to help elect Beto and defeat anti-choice Greg Abbott in November. Every donation brings us one step closer to a governor who will protect reproductive rights no matter what.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220504-1?refcode=ema20220504-187846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&refcode2=187846_444211_Q3U5OG&akid=187846%2E444211%2EQ3U5OG)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bft-em-20220504-1?refcode=ema20220504-187846&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&refcode2=187846_444211_Q3U5OG&akid=187846%2E444211%2EQ3U5OG)**
I’ll end with this. I’ve been a Texan all my life — and sometimes people from other states will question if things can ever really change for this state.
When I look at what we’re doing together with Beto’s campaign, _I know they can_.
Future generations are counting on us. Let’s do this.
—Cecile
Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas
Former President of Planned Parenthood

## Endorsement Edition!
|
---
Hello, For the past several days, I have found myself repeatedly telling my family and friends, “I am just _so_ excited!” I don’t know how else to better express my feelings about being the DFL endorsed candidate for MN House 2A. Going to St. Paul to represent my friends and neighbors has long been a dream of mine. Although it is still only the dawn of our campaign, I have already seen a spark of enthusiasm in so many people. They are hungry for a candidate that stands strong for rural Northwoods values and truly cares about improving our quality of life. We have an opportunity to make a real difference this year. However, I cannot do it alone! I need your help and support to get our message out there. Please let us know if you would like to volunteer for the campaign. We need help with parades & county fairs, door knocking & lit drops, phone banking and fundraising. Whether you support us for an hour or the entire season, **you** will make this campaign victorious! Thank you for believing in me and for your continued support.-Reed

Wade_. Yesterday, I met with protesters in Missoula to listen to their concerns and fears about this potential new ruling. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44923183/343690399/-10092236?refcode=em-5.4.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjI1ZjJlOC1kY2NiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5xqPCwrMdR2fDEepFp0BegV9xJKrk9Pyqtp6pICPWtw=) I was encouraged to see so many Montanans raising their voices against this ruling. What we are witnessing is an activist Supreme Court criminalizing a woman's constitutional right of bodily autonomy and privacy. Those supporting this ruling like to claim the mantle of “limited government.” There’s nothing “limited” about destroying individual rights in favor of social control, and that will be this ruling’s outcome. States across the country will punish doctors and women seeking reproductive health. **Just minutes after this opinion was released, Ryan Zinke posted on Facebook that he “applauded the court’s draft decision.”** It’s never been clearer what’s at stake in this election. This is not about Democrats vs. Republicans -- it’s a fight between personal freedom and the desire to dictate. subject: These heroes are counting on you
body:
You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6svni6oma649ga5h5rtal1sc2uth0er6gr4vh5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2dhkm9h3cor0sir76olnc9hmcttjclr38odmc4r3ct5hcho7csj1m1p34sr66urt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcc9kmko6fdr2coq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)

---
Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z27o9g8t73di7dk192a1uqsk4fcsi3nffiuqtlqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3onpiuscd6rc67ngm05kumu5nv5k1sftskbk20g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhpds9p87fdp29u6f13s1grev8tb3qr3oieiaub0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zat02au8m29a5qihuvefjpf1ljr62hcfeel3ctg0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmodi24f993qr8nq519tdefqlp0f5nd3757od3h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoemal8vum1blpb493lk63vrto4be592rsodsql8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z76g4tghm6g97ag47kk8subad2eppqkrqnhrpe4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day — this year and every year — please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr1fcahvkso0adf26bm0rqo05oilrhfrrfig159g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjovvcirtm963ce58itv4k30nh8n4oac27fpasj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4cdie0o72c1h2bs)
---

body:
| Team – I'm thrilled to congratulate Nan Whaley and Cheryl Stephens on their victory in yesterday's gubernatorial primary. Nan is the governor we need right now and I know Cheryl is the best possible lieutenant governor to help her get Ohio on track.

We need their leadership now more than ever. With the Supreme Court poised to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , a strong pro-choice leader in the statehouse is a necessity. Nan has always fought for reproductive freedom, and we desperately need her clarity and toughness. And more importantly, we need someone who knows how to win.

As mayor of Dayton, Nan saw the city through a recovery that brought everyone in. To quote Nan, when you're mayor you can't say, "that's not my problem." And she rolled up her sleeves to tackle the opioid crisis, expand our schools, boost the economy, and lead the city through crisis. Dayton is on the rise, but if you know Nan, you know she couldn't stop there.

She saw what was happening in Ohio – the rich were getting richer while working families fell behind. Far-right Republicans in the legislature got more and more extreme while people across Ohio were asking for real solutions to the problems they faced. So she got into the governor's race to bring the lessons she learned in Dayton to the rest of the state.

Nan has a vision for Ohio where everyone can get ahead, not just the super-wealthy who trade favors. We can be a state where our kids have real opportunities. And we should elect leaders who work as hard as everyday Ohioans who are fighting every single day to make ends meet. **It's this simple: she wants your pay to go up, your bills to go down, and your government to actually work for you.**

We've been building for this moment at the Ohio Democratic Party, so we won't sugarcoat it. This race is going to be tough. Ohio hasn't elected a Democratic governor since 2006. We've been drowned out by outside groups and dark money. But past does not have to be prologue. We CAN elect Nan, but only with your help.

You’d be hard-pressed to find a candidate more out-of-touch with
hardworking Ohioans than JD Vance. He’s endorsed by Donald Trump and has
the backing of Silicon Valley billionaire Peter Thiel’s $13.5 million
super PAC.

But even with all of that on his side—I have a one-point lead on him in
the polls, proving we have the momentum to flip Ohio blue. But I’m going
to need a whole lot of help because the stakes of our battleground race
just got a lot higher.

Now that the Supreme Court vote to overturn Roe v. Wade has been leaked,
we can’t afford to let JD anywhere near the Senate. He called pregnancy
from rape “inconvenient” and said overturning Roe would be a “victory.”

JD has the full backing of the entire Republican Party on his side, and

#

Erica will ALWAYS fight for reproductive freedom. That’s why Planned Parenthood, NARAL Pro-Choice, and other critical pro-choice organizations have thrown their full support behind our campaign.
But we’re up against a well-funded, anti-choice opponent who voted with Republicans to defund Planned Parenthood, restrict access to reproductive care and criminalize doctors who provide abortion services.
[**Our primary election is exactly 13 days away, and we can’t bet on winning. Will you chip in $5 today to elect Erica and stop an anti-choice Democrat from representing us in Congress?**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/52161?refcode=em20220504-1153&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1153%2E3698%2E3Lf0nG)

Sign our card >>>

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44923930/343693893/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmJmNTgwYS1lMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BOOZ5BImeszk8LSwVI-feqx6o-M1ZyIgUxV-gKwLEFE=) We celebrate teachers, Peter!

This week is Teacher Appreciation Week. It’s important to recognize their essential place in our society. I find today especially meaningful since my own mother is an educator - I grew up with a deep appreciation of the work teachers do every day to shape the next generation. My dad used to say, “Our best crop is kids!” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44923931/343693894/-2021300631?refcode=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmJmNTgwYS1lMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BOOZ5BImeszk8LSwVI-feqx6o-M1ZyIgUxV-gKwLEFE=&emci=2b83bfb4-c6cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225) _Deb’s mother, Lolly, when she was working as a teacher_ Teachers go above and beyond to make sure our children have the best possible education, and for the last two years, they’ve contended with challenges posed by educating during a pandemic.

**[I want to send my gratitude to teachers everywhere, and I hope you’ll join me by signing our e-card here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44923932/343693895/-2021300631?refcode=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmJmNTgwYS1lMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BOOZ5BImeszk8LSwVI-feqx6o-M1ZyIgUxV-gKwLEFE=&emci=2b83bfb4-c6cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44923933/343693896/-2021300631?refcode=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYmJmNTgwYS1lMWNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BOOZ5BImeszk8LSwVI-feqx6o-M1ZyIgUxV-gKwLEFE=&emci=2b83bfb4-c6cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ebbf580a-e1cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225) Peter, our children deserve an excellent education in our public schools. To facilitate that excellent education, teachers need resources - sufficient funding for their schools, access to paid leave, and salaries that reflect their critical roles.

In Congress, I will work to ensure our teachers have access to those resources.

| Fellow activist, we have some bad news.

With the Supreme Court’s extremist draft opinion threatening to overturn the right to bodily autonomy, expanding the electorate for this year’s elections have become even more crucial.

The Governor’s veto power could be the only thing standing between the Republican legislature and our reproductive rights. The Republican seat in the Senate could be the difference between federal action and eternal filibusters. The state legislature could even go from attacking our rights to protecting them, if we flip enough seats.

Those are all things that the majority of Americans AND Pennsylvanians believe in and are very much on the ballot in Pennsylvania this election. This means we have to push even harder to expand the electorate in the Commonwealth to include often ignored communities of color and the youth and be sure they make their voices heard in every election — twice a year.

**[Fellow activist, we have to stop letting the far-right minority of Americans and elected officials dictate how the rest of us can live. That means making our government reflect the values of all Americans, and the only surefire way to do it is expanding the electorate. subject: Thank you for everything
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Timken for Ohio
body:
I couldn’t of accomplished anything without you

|
---
Dear friends,

While yesterday’s results did not go the way we had hoped, I am so incredibly proud of the campaign we ran. Team Timken is truly unlike any other.

To all of my supporters who have been here from the beginning – thank you. Your endless generosity and support mean the world to me. There is no greater feeling than knowing we built such a deep, devoted grassroots army in Ohio and beyond. It’s what kept me going day after day throughout our campaign.

It has been the honor of my life to earn the support and endorsement of so many Ohioans - including Senator Rob Portman and over 200 conservative leaders across the state.

Although my campaign is at an end, this time in our nation is just beginning. The time for change, and most importantly, unity. Ohio must come together, and I know Team Timken will serve as leaders in America's next political chapter. I am so passionate about the future of our nation. And I know you are too.

Much is changing, but our fight remains the same. We must always fight to SAVE OHIO and Take Back the Senate! Congratulations to JD Vance, I fully support him in his next fight for the future of our state.

Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU for your undying support.

For Ohio,

Jane Timken

body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
The middle class built America – but who built the middle class?
The answer: Labor Unions.
As Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll kickstart our economy by investing in critical 21st century infrastructure projects like public transit, statewide 5G, and renewable energy to create 100,000 new family-supporting jobs. I’ll partner with Labor Unions like LiUNA Mid-Atlantic Region to create a jobs training program, and I’ll make sure every public works project is paired with a Project Labor Agreement and Community Benefits Agreement to ensure good wages and good working conditions for local workers.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=20.22]
We have an opportunity to build a new Maryland economy that works for everyone in the years to come. You deserve a leader who isn’t afraid to fight for economic justice. As Governor, I’ll proudly partner with our Union brothers and sisters to deliver.
If you agree that Maryland needs a leader who will fight for the interests of Maryland’s workers, then I could use your help today. We’re fighting to win this competitive race, and we have just weeks to go before the July 19 primary election. If you are able, can I count on you to help power our movement to victory?
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/unionpf]
My grassroots campaign is relying on supporters like you to help us scale up our statewide operation in these final, critical weeks. Your contribution will help us get our message out to all corners of Maryland, so that we can build the critical mass of support needed to win this race.
I can’t thank you enough for your continued support of our inclusive people-powered movement. Grassroots supporters like you are a force-multiplier in our efforts to reach voters, and we simply could not have gotten this far without your support. It is thanks to you that we are able to print more field literature and yard signs, run more ads using the latest cutting-edge tools, knock on more doors, place more calls, and ultimately secure our victory on July 19.
Together, we’re going to change the way that government does business, and build a new people-centered administration that proudly champions the interests of Maryland’s workers and small businesses. Enough talk – let’s get it done.
Thank you,

Peter, I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why your response to my priorities survey is so important.

Growing up, I didn’t have power or privilege. I was born in Brooklyn to hardworking parents and received all of my education through the New York City public school system. And, like millions of other New Yorkers, I had no real platform to speak up about the decisions being made that would directly affect me and my family.

I know what it is to feel powerless and voiceless. **That’s why, when I made history by becoming the first Black woman ever to be attorney general of New York, I vowed to never let another New Yorker feel voiceless.**

**May 4, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**

| |
# Bill McSwain: I will permanently cut the gas tax in half, unleash PA energy resources
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain today held a press conference in Philadelphia to address Pennsylvania's highest in the nation gas tax and the burden of ever-rising gas prices brought about by Joe Biden, Tom Wolf and Josh Shapiro.

In his remarks, McSwain promised to permanently cut the PA gas tax by 50% as Governor, and stressed that temporary solutions are not enough. McSwain also shared his plan to restore fiscal responsibility to Pennsylvania by cutting wasteful government spending and repealing burdensome regulations.

McSwain emphasized the importance of electing a conservative outsider who will not allow career politicians to continue wasting taxpayer dollars while imposing crushing taxes on families:
---
|
> _**"For too long, hard-working families across the Commonwealth have had to grapple with uncontrolled government spending and a crippling gas tax. This is unacceptable. Why are we as a state punishing our own citizens who are working hard to support their families?
>
> As Governor, I will permanently reduce the state gas tax by 50% and restore a business and family-friendly culture so that our economy can thrive." **_
---
|
---
|
---
| McSwain was introduced by prominent local businessman Bill Heeney, owner of Instant Courier, Inc.:
---
|
> **_"_**_**Pennsylvania businesses have suffered under eight years of the intrusive and controlling policies of Tom Wolf. It's time for a Governor who will support and empower business owners, not stifle them. That Governor will be **_**_Bill McSwain. Bill is a leader who will stand up in defense of working families and who will implement the pro-business and pro-energy policies necessary to get our economy back on track. There is no one better to lead our Commonwealth into a new era of prosperity than Bill McSwain._****_" _**
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=fd9069044a&e=b1ec95759b)

name: Team Lizzie
subject: #TeamLizzie Weekly Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd]
Thank you to everyone who pitched in ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline.
#TeamLizzie worked hard and we ended April in a strong place. Every dollar we raise helps us connect with all of the new voters in our district and lay the groundwork for re-electing Lizzie.
We know the Supreme Court’s draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade is on a lot of people’s minds today. It’s certainly on ours. Yesterday, Lizzie joined Houstonians downtown at the #BansOffOurBodies [https://twitter.com/hashtag/BansOffOurBodies?src=hashtag_click] rally, visiting with constituents and catching up with some of the original members of #TeamLizzie from the 2018 campaign!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd]
As Lizzie said yesterday, we cannot rely solely on the courts to protect our autonomy, dignity, and privacy. We need to keep fighting — and winning elections.
We need to elect leaders who will stand up for our rights — leaders like Lizzie, who voted to codify Roe and make it the law of the land, who introduced a bill to put a stop to abortion bounties, and who is fighting to make sure all Texans have access to safe, affordable, nonjudgmental reproductive care.
This week is National Teachers Appreciation Week!
At one point or another, all of us have benefitted from the wisdom and support of a great teacher. Today, we want to thank all of the teachers on #TeamLizzie and in TX-07 who make it their life’s work to engage, inspire, and educate our young students — that includes our campaign treasurer and middle school history teacher, Gordon Center, as well as so many of Lizzie’s elementary, high school, and college teachers who have supported our campaign for years!
With the challenges of teaching during the pandemic, and all the challenges in this moment in our politics, teachers have gone above and beyond for our kids. Lizzie will keep fighting to help teachers have the resources and opportunities they need to do their work that is vital to the future of our country and our world!
Thanks to them, and to you, for being part of the team,
Team Lizzie
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220504wu?refcode=lpfe220504wu_nd]

Dear Friend,

Ben Shapiro invited me on to his show a few days ago. Do please watch it if you have a few moments, by clicking on the image below:
---

Douglas Carswell's Interview with Ben Shapiro
| Ben and I discussed how the federal government is raising taxes, while conservative-run states like Mississippi are starting to cut taxes.

**The Mississippi Center for Public Policy helped to spearhead the campaign to axe the state income tax, which resulted in the largest tax break in the history of our state.**

By cutting taxes, conservative-run states offer America an alternative roadmap to recovery. It is delightful to see Mississippi getting national recognition and coverage as our state leads the way!

---
| |
---
Warm Regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
---
|

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsCZNjgH2N

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osCZNjgH2N

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

body:
If the Supreme Court draft decision on Roe v. Wade becomes law, the impact on people serving in the military would be disastrous.
#
Derek —
If the Supreme Court draft decision on Roe v. Wade becomes law, the impact on people serving in the military would be disastrous.
And some experts believe it could harm military readiness.
Consider the facts:
First, more than half of all states are poised to ban abortion if the Supreme Court overturns Roe v. Wade. States like Texas, Georgia and Florida, which are home to hundreds of thousands of troops and military families on some of the nation’s largest military bases.
Now consider that most active duty troops and military families don’t get to choose where they are stationed — meaning that safe, legal abortion will be inaccessible to them if this decision becomes law.
Many of the state abortion bans don’t make an exception for rape or incest, and restrict the kinds of emergency procedures that are necessary to save the life of the mother in a worst-case scenario.
An existing federal rule known as the Hyde Amendment already makes it illegal for abortions to be performed at military medical facilities. And Tricare, the health insurance provided to troops and military families, doesn’t cover the cost of abortions at private clinics, either.
So, now you have hundreds of thousands of troops and military families, many of whom are not paid a ton of money, who will have to cover the cost of abortion on their own, not to mention cover the cost of travel out of state, a stay at a hotel and any additional recovery costs.
To top it off, active duty troops also have to get permission from their chain of command to leave in order to obtain this extremely private medical procedure.
The Supreme Court wants to _force_ our servicemembers and their family members to carry unwanted or unsafe pregnancies to term.
Servicemembers cannot deploy while pregnant, which harms military readiness. A servicemember who becomes pregnant against their will and cannot obtain a safe, legal abortion, will not be able to deploy -- taking them out of the fight.
So what is someone in the military with an unwanted pregnancy to do?
The point is, it should be a private choice made by a person and their doctor. Not their Commanding Officer, Justice Alito, or anyone else.
Over the course of the next few weeks, we are going to be elevating the voices of veterans who have faced this very choice personally.
We hope you’ll help us make sure their voices are heard.

In the last year, the Crist campaign has amassed:

**And this morning, St. Pete Polls released a poll showing Charlie Crist with a +33 lead on his next opponent in the primary. It’s not an anomaly and it's not by accident.**

Democrats in Florida know — we have to build infrastructure and momentum for the general election against Ron DeSantis. And thanks to supporters like you, that’s exactly what this team is doing.

To put ourselves in the best possible position to defeat Ron DeSantis, we need to consolidate around Charlie Crist now.

body:
the SCOTUS decision

|

Folks, We wanted to address the right-wing elephant in the room: the leaked SCOTUS decision that would overturn _Roe v. Wade_. **Let’s be clear: Indiana Democrats support all aspects of life and freedom — and it’s exactly why we support a woman’s choice to make her own decisions about her body.** **We’ll also be blunt: Ending Roe does not end abortions. It ends access to safe and legal abortions** (the law of the land for nearly 50 years) — especially for vulnerable communities across Indiana and nationwide. **Democrats know that healthcare decisions should be made in consultation with a doctor or health care professional – not a politician.** **And make no mistake, Democrats do not root for abortion.** We understand that it is sometimes a necessary procedure. If a woman is raped, she should not be forced to have her rapist’s baby. If a girl experiences incest, she should not be forced to have a child. And, if a woman’s life is on the line — she should not be forced to die. Hoosiers largely agree with these facts. Only about **17%** **of Hoosiers believe abortion should be criminalized under all circumstances**. And, about **56%** of Hoosiers have opposed extreme abortion measures like Mike Pence’s 2016 law — which forced women to have a funeral for stillborn babies. Everyone has a right to their own opinion because this is a personal issue. But, **Democrats support policies that reflect the entire state — _not only a slice of voters or a radical Supreme Court._** **We think this decision should rest between a woman or family and a doctor – not between a woman or family and politicians in Indianapolis or Washington, D.C.!** There was already so much at stake in the midterm elections this November – and now the stakes got even higher. We must come together, support women, and defeat extremism so we can all live in a world and a state that is progressing forward, not falling behind. Indiana Democratic Party

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: 5 years ago today, my life changed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220504&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220504&amount=28]
Friend,
Five years ago today, I made a decision that changed my life. I decided to run for Congress.
It was a decision I had only been thinking through for a little while. After the 2016 election, it was very clear the tone and tenor of our politics had changed – and it inspired me to get more involved in politics. As someone who had served Presidents of both parties in the national security field, I could tell that something had fundamentally shifted.
But, I hadn’t made up my mind yet – until exactly five years ago today. I was sitting in my living room in Holly, watching live on CNN as then-President Trump and Congressional Republicans held a party in the Rose Garden to celebrate the repeal of the Affordable Care Act. In the middle of the festivities was my then-Congressman – laughing and beaming with pride. He had spent months avoiding any type of public event to hear constituent concerns about health care, and just like that, he was celebrating his vote to dismantle protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
It broke me.
I turned to my husband, Dave, and said: “No. You don’t get to ignore your constituents, vote against their interests, and keep your job.” The military has a term for this: it’s called dereliction of duty. It’s a fireable offense. We decided that day we would fire him, and in November 2018, we did just that.
Health care is personal to me. In 2011, my mom died of ovarian cancer. She had thankfully beaten cancer as a young mom, but for the rest of her life she had a pre-existing condition -- which meant getting health care coverage was always a struggle. When she did have coverage, it was her highest bill, over $1,000 per month with a $10,000 deductible. And when she was diagnosed in 2009 with advanced ovarian cancer, unbeknownst to our family she had let her coverage lapse in order to pay other bills.
We sometimes forget that the House voted on a full repeal, including protections for people with preexisting conditions, and that the only reason we still have these protections is because one man, Senator John McCain, voted against his party. But that doesn’t mean attacks on health coverage have stopped. Since taking office, I’ve been fighting tooth and nail to make common sense improvements to our health care system – solutions to issues that impact you no matter your political beliefs like the truly insane cost of prescription drugs.
I could have never foreseen this five years ago, but I’m thrilled with the progress we’ve been able to make. Thank you for being on this journey with me.

Elissa

Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFj81qBCEQhJ9m5ubg-DPqYQ6BMLfNIQRylFbbXcn8oe6GvH3cvECgDkUXVH8V5uADjL5PM6OMUUnFqIRgZtAYKYjAmvSkpOsEhRVzHTKed7cmD3uF8hWP7HHwx9bfZiGVmYxD6kFL44yUXFOllRZcTaMZ-8-LvUBa0359gw3nXKPNxQJaeHhS0p4Kkg1-rCSCMGZZv863Ws_S8ZeOLU0F_T3jADuGoz6_tltryk8a8sCKGfZCPO7Ntci74KLjYCLDMTIjjeau40s57o3a-iNgx1_fPxamJOd9nsP5ndY1lUm1udetsf5Nq_-j_gJrTGn3)

When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFj81qBCEQhJ9m5ubg-DPqYQ6BMLfNIQRylFbbXcn8oe6GvH3cvECgDkUXVH8V5uADjL5PM6OMUUnFqIRgZtAYKYjAmvSkpOsEhRVzHTKed7cmD3uF8hWP7HHwx9bfZiGVmYxD6kFL44yUXFOllRZcTaMZ-8-LvUBa0359gw3nXKPNxQJaeHhS0p4Kkg1-rCSCMGZZv863Ws_S8ZeOLU0F_T3jADuGoz6_tltryk8a8sCKGfZCPO7Ntci74KLjYCLDMTIjjeau40s57o3a-iNgx1_fPxamJOd9nsP5ndY1lUm1udetsf5Nq_-j_gJrTGn3)

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyFj81qBCEQhJ9m5ubg-DPqYQ6BMLfNIQRylFbbXcn8oe6GvH3cvECgDkUXVH8V5uADjL5PM6OMUUnFqIRgZtAYKYjAmvSkpOsEhRVzHTKed7cmD3uF8hWP7HHwx9bfZiGVmYxD6kFL44yUXFOllRZcTaMZ-8-LvUBa0359gw3nXKPNxQJaeHhS0p4Kkg1-rCSCMGZZv863Ws_S8ZeOLU0F_T3jADuGoz6_tltryk8a8sCKGfZCPO7Ntci74KLjYCLDMTIjjeau40s57o3a-iNgx1_fPxamJOd9nsP5ndY1lUm1udetsf5Nq_-j_gJrTGn3)

clean_body: | | | Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump. This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is more important now than ever — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home. The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam. * Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day — this year and every year — please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more. Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honorary Grand Marshal National Memorial Day Parade | The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. | | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44928335/343717488/43356809?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4YjkwMzk0LWY1Y2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ijMmgRn9aqkU07H82mDrkcZv7x3Sw9Pe8DgjjowmJlw=&emci=36b1cf95-efcb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8b90394-f5cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) |

| | Hey Peter, The I-5 bridge across the Columbia River is being replaced, which is potentially exciting news, because we’ll have the opportunity to invest in new light rail. But, we need to make sure that the new bridge doesn’t lead to an increase in traffic–and climate pollution. Luckily, we still have the chance to weigh in. [**Will you send a message to the Interstate Bridge Replacement Project, and ask them to make the new I-5 bridge climate friendly?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44928351/343717504/43356809?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4YjkwMzk0LWY1Y2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ijMmgRn9aqkU07H82mDrkcZv7x3Sw9Pe8DgjjowmJlw=&emci=36b1cf95-efcb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8b90394-f5cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Right now, the plan is to create an 8 lane or 10 lane bridge, leading to more cars, and more climate pollution. [**Will you tell the Interstate Bridge Replacement Project to decrease the number of lanes?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44928366/343717519/43356809?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4YjkwMzk0LWY1Y2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ijMmgRn9aqkU07H82mDrkcZv7x3Sw9Pe8DgjjowmJlw=&emci=36b1cf95-efcb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8b90394-f5cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) The I-5 bridge should have more like 6 lanes in order to prevent additional traffic, and it should prioritize public transit. Studies have shown that more lanes lead to more cars–and transportation is already Oregon’s number one source of climate pollution. [**Will you write to the Interstate Bridge Replacement Project, and ask them to make sure the bridge has fewer car lanes?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44928374/343717538/43356809?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4YjkwMzk0LWY1Y2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ijMmgRn9aqkU07H82mDrkcZv7x3Sw9Pe8DgjjowmJlw=&emci=36b1cf95-efcb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8b90394-f5cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) We also want to make sure that the I-5 bridge centers equity and justice, and that it reduces the impact on the residents of Hayden Island. This is our opportunity to make sure the I-5 crossing is climate-friendly and equitable. [**Please speak up now–before their meeting on Thursday–to make sure that the new I-5 bridge prioritizes light rail and doesn’t increase traffic pollution.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44928377/343717541/43356809?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4YjkwMzk0LWY1Y2ItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ijMmgRn9aqkU07H82mDrkcZv7x3Sw9Pe8DgjjowmJlw=&emci=36b1cf95-efcb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f8b90394-f5cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Thank you,

Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV |

name: Adam Schiff
subject: On the ground in Kyiv
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=234%2E5257348%2ESiJIXp ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

If you’ve been reading my emails over the past few years, you know that I
believe we’re engaged in a global struggle against the rise of autocracy —
and how critical it is that democracy wins, both at home and abroad. This
weekend, I joined a trip that brought the stakes home in a way nothing
else could.

I wanted to tell you about my trip to Kyiv, Ukraine four days ago. Along
with Speaker Pelosi and three of my House colleagues, we met with
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, as the first Congressional
delegation to meet with him since the outset of the war.

A little over two months ago, Russian President Vladimir Putin — in an act
of reckless aggression against his democratic neighbor — launched an
invasion of Ukraine.

This war has not gone as Putin expected. And that is largely because of
the indomitable spirit and resilience of the Ukrainian people. Even in the
relative calm of Kyiv, where Putin’s forces were repelled just weeks
earlier, the cost of this war to the Ukrainian people was evident. As was
the absolute necessity that we support Ukraine in its struggle for
freedom.

The war has led to a humanitarian and economic crisis throughout Ukraine.
Cities have been leveled, millions of refugees have fled in advance of the
Russian army, and those trapped in war zones in the East are struggling to
survive. And war crimes, including the deliberate murder of civilians and
the rape of Ukrainian women and girls, have been well documented.

That’s why a delegation of us, led by Speaker Nancy Pelosi, went to
Ukraine to meet with President Zelenskyy in Kyiv on Saturday.

Derek, it was an experience I will never forget. In many areas
of the city, the streets of Kyiv were buzzing with activity, as people
tried to go about their lives, even as cruise missiles continued to fall
on the city with an unnerving randomness. In other neighborhoods, there
was an eerie quiet, and all over the city a curfew sent people indoors by
sundown. Through it all, the Ukrainian people remain unbowed.

I had never met President Zelenskyy before seeing him in Kyiv under these
extraordinary circumstances. But I was already well familiar with him
before the war — he was, of course, the same Zelenskyy that I prosecuted
Trump for trying to blackmail over military aid during the first
impeachment trial. Like so many others, I have been awed by his courage
and leadership. Underestimated by many, Putin most of all, he has proven
himself to be a rare leader, rallying his nation under impossible
circumstances. Meeting him in person, he projected a calm that was all the
more remarkable for the dangerous and chaotic situation all around him.

We met with President Zelenskyy and his top advisors for three hours. We
heard their requests for more humanitarian, economic, and military
assistance. And we promised we would not only hear them, but also act on
them as quickly as possible when we returned to Washington, DC.

The urgency is real, as the war enters a new phase and Ukraine needs the
long range artillery and anti-ship munitions to hold the Russians at bay.
Tragically, the war is far from over, as Ukrainians fight hour by hour to
prevent Russia from advancing in the East and claiming more territory and
lives. But we can help it come to a more rapid end, by supplying Ukraine
with the assistance it needs, and further constricting the economic
sanctions on Putin’s Russia. Ordinary Russians must be made to feel the
murderous folly of their Kremlin dictator.

This war is just the latest front in the struggle against oppression
around the world. Ukraine is a young democracy, and that was something
that their authoritarian neighbor could not abide. This was an attack on
Ukraine, yes, but also against the very idea that a free people get to
chart their own destiny.

That’s why what happens in Ukraine matters. Right now, authoritarians are
watching what is occurring, and wondering how the world will respond. So
far, we have stood united and stronger than anyone expected. But the
struggle is nowhere near the end - that much was clear in Kyiv. And what
happens there will echo across Europe and the world, for decades to come.

We all have a role to play in protecting democracy at home and abroad. We
became the arsenal of democracy is the 1930s and 1940s, and we must do so
again today. I’m so thankful for what you’ve done and will continue to do.

Talk soon.

— Adam

| | This week's leaked draft of the Supreme Court's decision on Roe. v. Wade has many feeling deeply anxious and fearful. It's important to remember that Monday night's leaked draft from the Supreme Court isn't final – the right to an abortion is still the law of the land. That said, if the final decision reflects the draft we saw, then **reproductive rights that have been protected for 49 years could be stripped away instantly.** Pro-choice advocacy needs our support now more than ever. Please contribute today to NARAL Pro-Choice America: [support naral now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44929016/343719833/1440790869?refcode=2022-05-04-andy-kim&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=6d0444f8-f6cb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDA0NDRmOC1mNmNiLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=noRfvXJaHMgLWLikfgYKIRhfE2q74-JTtG0YY6sX_U8=) This is a stark reminder that we can't take anything for granted, even after a half century. Let's be clear: overturning _Roe_ won't stop abortion, it will just make it more dangerous. And almost all of that danger will be borne by women, particularly women of color. It's true that overturning _Roe v. Wade_ doesn't mean abortion is banned everywhere; sixteen states, including New Jersey, have laws on the books protecting the right to choose, no matter what the Court decides. But this issue is bigger than that; **the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right. Human rights don't stop at the state line, and we can't allow regressive, anti-democratic judges, governors, or legislators to take basic rights away from anyone, regardless of where they live.** This isn't hypothetical or in the distant future. If the Court's final decision reflects this draft, then women's right to make their own health care decisions will be gone this summer. **We have to understand the importance of this decision and meet the urgency of the moment.** Our movement has to organize a pro-choice tidal wave at the polls this year, electing leaders who are ready on day one to enshrine the right to choose in a clear, definitive federal law, and who will never stop fighting for reproductive freedom for everyone, _everywhere_ in this country. clean_body: | | | This week's leaked draft of the Supreme Court's decision on Roe. v. Wade has many feeling deeply anxious and fearful. It's important to remember that Monday night's leaked draft from the Supreme Court isn't final – the right to an abortion is still the law of the land. That said, if the final decision reflects the draft we saw, then reproductive rights that have been protected for 49 years could be stripped away instantly. Pro-choice advocacy needs our support now more than ever. Please contribute today to NARAL Pro-Choice America: = This is a stark reminder that we can't take anything for granted, even after a half century. Let's be clear: overturning Roe won't stop abortion, it will just make it more dangerous. And almost all of that danger will be borne by women, particularly women of color. It's true that overturning Roe v. Wade doesn't mean abortion is banned everywhere; sixteen states, including New Jersey, have laws on the books protecting the right to choose, no matter what the Court decides. But this issue is bigger than that; the right of every person to choose what to do with their own body is an essential human right. Human rights don't stop at the state line, and we can't allow regressive, anti-democratic judges, governors, or legislators to take basic rights away from anyone, regardless of where they live. This isn't hypothetical or in the distant future. If the Court's final decision reflects this draft, then women's right to make their own health care decisions will be gone this summer. We have to understand the importance of this decision and meet the urgency of the moment. Our movement has to organize a pro-choice tidal wave at the polls this year, electing leaders who are ready on day one to enshrine the right to choose in a clear, definitive federal law, and who will never stop fighting for reproductive freedom for everyone, everywhere in this country. = Andy Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution to NARAL Pro-Choice America instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress. ---|--- | This email was sent by Andy Kim for Congress P.O. name: Jessica Cisneros
subject: Why we need to defeat anti-choice Henry Cuellar
body:
Despite the news from SCOTUS, there is still a fire within us to fight for change.
#
Peter,
We can’t count on the Supreme Court to protect our constitutional right to abortion. We need strong advocates in Congress to fight to codify _Roe v. Wade_ now.
**Henry Cuellar was the only Democrat to vote with Republicans against codifying _Roe v. Wade_.** I will always stand for our health care and the right to choose. In 20 days, I face off against Cuellar in our primary runoff.
[Let’s defeat the last anti-choice Democrat in the U.S. House. Split a contribution to my campaign and Justice Democrats today so we can oust Henry Cuellar in 20 days.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105607?refcode=em20220504-23180&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=23180%2E1203867%2ETv10JV)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105607?refcode=em20220504-23180&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23180%2E1203867%2ETv10JV)**
With the future of abortion rights on the line in Texas and nationally, we need progressive champions in Congress who will fight to codify _Roe v. Wade_ by passing legislation to ensure that all people have unfettered access to abortion care, and who will repeal the Hyde Amendment to make abortion more affordable and accessible. That’s why I’m taking on anti-choice Henry Cuellar.
While this is a dark time, we cannot despair. **We have to fight for reproductive justice once and for all.** But as long as anti-choice Democrats like Henry Cuellar remain in power, abortion rights will remain on the chopping block. His anti-choice record speaks for himself and we’re done with politicians like Cuellar legislating against our control of our own bodies.
[We have the last word on May 24th to defeat the last anti-choice Democrat in the House. Texas deserves better than Henry Cuellar. Donate now to my campaign and Justice Democrats.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105607?refcode=em20220504-23180&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23180%2E1203867%2ETv10JV)
Let’s do this,
Jessica

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=23180%2E1203867%2ETv10JV) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=23180%2E1203867%2ETv10JV) and your state public health department.
---

| | **A Message From Bill McSwain **
---
| May 4, 2022 Friends and Supporters,

The days have flown by since I first announced my candidacy for Governor back in September. It's hard to believe that we are just two weeks away from the May 17 primary election!

I know that we can win, but I need your help to cross the finish line. From door knocking to phone banking, writing postcards to your neighbors or putting signs in your yard or around your neighborhood, there is an opportunity to contribute in whatever way you can.

Please click below to hear my special pre-primary message:

None of this would be possible without the many friends and supporters who have helped share our message of liberty, prosperity, and a bright future for Pennsylvania. Thank you for your time, support, and generosity!

A primary victory is just around the corner!

Yours in the fight,

Bill McSwain

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: A pledge to protect the unborn
body:
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=610fb0454af64ecd807227730577f61c&_e=a6u553hunQtUdk-oi_-oJyJ8oZG5pmMz9XWsK97zO-4OLT8t1vlaLePj0MmhA5_ZDLPuPlgFDJPd2CGwSD_NWrgC9PforTxBZj0YtCXLWEuSVAIq8VxYevAKk1WAnYQkFMmmNIb8E3qsJBiTuTxskUGpRblwhv-j5vuz-DBIp-14Y7foMUN_ZO_orQfkAgWf6oOiQFZUEmzsxbuaztCtvhnVHNnYIdYnCoB65K4_jl352x80FDBozMd0iicZm9F0quBkCRQFBUY973-7ML5cpeRwBCv_GAPaUh8FJ45lAOnlseXM0LmYUnPKgBkOKnfeXncTrvweOXv3q183wZutFgar_vPR23IKX3_rPaKsI5cRRJVm5kLGEaIsSWiWDZO7uiOmqgwFPUUmnudnxeJS3f3FAxRWmKwjIpjdC1TRFfc2Gpprb_jc8aza4TSfCNBM)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=610fb0454af64ecd807227730577f61c&_e=a6u553hunQtUdk-oi_-oJyJ8oZG5pmMz9XWsK97zO-4OLT8t1vlaLePj0MmhA5_ZDLPuPlgFDJPd2CGwSD_NWrgC9PforTxBZj0YtCXLWEuSVAIq8VxYevAKk1WAnYQkFMmmNIb8E3qsJBiTuTxskUGpRblwhv-j5vuz-DBIp-14Y7foMUN_ZO_orQfkAgWf6oOiQFZUEmzsxbuaztCtvhnVHNnYIdYnCoB65K4_jl0WReDih5MRnLXZxM8dlvp8hyF0KHiPs1ta2dVz32kpy4KwUikr3Cf2aI_0r3Oik6JxsKIENqzxXr2-TBsbkR-HF6rNlTG9DtZ9_DyDvPR0loIWiSAJCaX3Y1EDMAkiGu20Bmw_X-0XlEsdVp2XYebEh7JjKg0Xp0kJpte_Nzlb9-Y8jJ_3vRulgD_Am4w-ZA8XA8Cg-gUXDwgl86sMhnEi) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=610fb0454af64ecd807227730577f61c&_e=a6u553hunQtUdk-oi_-oJyJ8oZG5pmMz9XWsK97zO-4OLT8t1vlaLePj0MmhA5_ZDLPuPlgFDJPd2CGwSD_NWrgC9PforTxBZj0YtCXLWEuSVAIq8VxYevAKk1WAnYQkFMmmNIb8E3qsJBiTuTxskUGpRblwhv-j5vuz-DBIp-14Y7foMUN_ZO_orQfkAgWf6oOiQFZUEmzsxbuaztCtvhnVHNnYIdYnCoB65K4_jl209ePXHxHb8ZXnW-ugHLPtvGWwaNDZndsMCNjW_rM9MWOUhyXP5xw5_f0cNBJ9Q0Oaha--DQkO0o36RDwpoj4hbF9kd73dasphzSfLxSo7SisLxitJMyu3rzYlJ_sdWhyEUksgZJz4Xuc02SdC_oSRiwn1uackylcF03XmMAMz2H9mnzfqHsrthpuqcZ1MWfL1JVOv5351R1XqV4sffL2R) Regards,
